errors.text: The proposed refractory alloy and rapid-solidification/sub-solvus-annealing route do not reconstruct the CoCrFeNiTi high-energy-ball-milling plus spark-plasma-sintering system.
The claimed ductile VEC window of 4.4-4.8 contradicts the cited evidence, which reports ductile alloys at VEC <=4.4 and brittle alloys at VEC >=4.6.
No cited evidence demonstrates that the proposed refractory compositions retain grains below 50 nm after annealing at 800-1000 °C or form the asserted BCC+B2 constitution.
The BCC+B2 evidence comes from an Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni alloy and is transferred to Nb-Mo-Ta-W-V or Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr without phase-stability evidence.
The predicted strength and ductility are inferred from an alloy strengthened by a Laves phase, despite the hypothesis explicitly excluding that mechanism.
The falsification experiment lacks grain-size-matched and phase-state-matched controls, so it cannot distinguish grain-boundary/B2 strengthening from simple solid-solution strengthening.
